mechanism: Azithromycin may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of guanfacine, increasing guanfacine plasma concentrations and enhancing alpha-2 adrenergic effects including hypotension and CNS depression.
action: Monitor blood pressure and clinical effects of guanfacine during azithromycin therapy; consider dose adjustment of guanfacine if hypotension or excessive sedation develops.
